sample.atom: SELECT feature_id AS id, feature_order, COALESCE(item_kind, kind) AS kind, status, COALESCE(payload->'_ei'->>'severity', payload->>'severity') AS severity, (payload->>'needsHuman') AS needs_human, (payload->'_claimHold') AS claim_hold, taken_by FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE workspace_id = 'papercusp-workspace' AND (harness_slug = 'harness:papercusp' OR harness_slug = 'operator:papercusp-workspace') AND feature_order IS NOT NULL AND status = 'open' ORDER BY feature_order ASC LIMIT 20
SELECT feature_id FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE title ILIKE '%DEGENERATED to pure TTL-ordering%' ORDER BY created_ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT feature_id, item_kind, status, taken_by, taken_at, last_progress_at, left(title,70) AS title, source_plan_item_ids FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE harness_slug='papercusp' AND (source_plan_item_ids && ARRAY['P-013','P-014'] OR title ILIKE '%WebSocket shim%') ORDER BY updated_ts DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT feature_id, kind, status, left(title,70) AS title, taken_by IS NOT NULL AS held, to_timestamp(updated_ts/1000) AS updated FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE taken_by = 'su-6335790e-3f65-4849-b4d5-a43702cc9650' ORDER BY updated_ts DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT feature_id, left(title, 130) AS txt, to_timestamp(created_ts/1000) AS created FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE title LIKE '%999999%' OR COALESCE(summary,'') LIKE '%999999%' ORDER BY created_ts DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT feature_id, status, assignee, to_char(to_timestamp(created_ts/1000),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, left(title,95) AS title FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND title ILIKE '%doc-steward%' ORDER BY created_ts DESC LIMIT 60

SELECT feature_id, status, goal_id IS NOT NULL AS stamped, payload->'plan_item' AS plan_item, left(title,44) AS title FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND title LIKE '[V-00%' ORDER BY feature_id

SELECT feature_id, status, item_kind, title, to_timestamp(created_ts/1000) AS created, to_timestamp(closed_ts/1000) AS closed, taken_by, terminal_reason FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE title ILIKE '%doc-drift sweep%' ORDER BY created_ts
SELECT feature_id, status, taken_by, left(title,60) AS title FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE title LIKE 'P-028%' AND harness_slug='papercusp' ORDER BY created_ts DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT feature_id, status, title, taken_at FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE taken_by = 'su-a80b0154-7891-4dc5-82e8-0bdc976c323f' AND status NOT IN ('done','closed','resolved','deprecated','dropped','passed')

SELECT feature_id, status, to_timestamp(created_ts/1000.0)::date AS created, left(title, 95) AS title FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE harness_slug = 'papercusp' AND item_kind = 'feature' AND status = 'open' AND to_timestamp(created_ts/1000.0) < now() - interval '14 days' AND last_progress_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_ts
SELECT feature_id, title, status FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE harness_slug='papercusp' AND title ILIKE '%revocation-propagation%' ORDER BY created_ts DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT feature_id, title, status, created_ts, taken_by FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE workspace_id = 'papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug = 'papercusp' AND title ILIKE '%loop:arm%' ORDER BY created_ts DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT feature_id,status,created_ts,title,left(summary,350) summary_head, regexp_replace(title,'.*— ([^(]+) \(owner.*','\1') AS outcome FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND status NOT IN ('done','dropped','resolved','closed','passed','deprecated') AND title LIKE 'LOOP WEDGED:%' ORDER BY created_ts
SELECT id, kind, state, assignee, left(title, 120) AS title, updated_at FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE title ILIKE '%vertex%' OR payload::text ILIKE '%vertex%' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT id, kind, state, left(title,80) AS title FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND assignee='su-70b6af5b-161b-4f48-a660-bf0e05a1af44' AND state NOT IN ('done','dropped','resolved','closed','deprecated') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT id, kind, status, title, updated_at FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE title ILIKE '%coupl%' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 40
SELECT id, state, assignee, left(title,110) AS title FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE state='wip' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT id, state, created_by, created_at, title FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND title ILIKE 'Loop iteration%' AND state NOT IN ('done','dropped','resolved','closed','deprecated','passed') ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 60

SELECT w.id, left(w.title, 110) AS title FROM harness_shared.work_items w WHERE w.harness_slug = 'papercusp' AND w.status = 'open' AND w.taken_by IS NULL AND w.title LIKE '%sidecar%' ORDER BY w.title LIMIT 60
